Research Use & Medical Information Notice

All products offered by Atlas Longevity are supplied exclusively for laboratory and in-vitro research purposes. They are not intended for human or animal consumption or administration.

Medical Information

Content available through this website is provided for research, educational, and informational purposes only.

Product descriptions, scientific summaries, research discussions, protocol references, articles, and other materials should not be considered medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or a recommendation to use any particular compound.

For questions relating to your health, medication, or treatment, consult an appropriately qualified healthcare professional.


Research Protocols & Dosage References

Our website may reference quantities, dosages, protocols, concentrations, or administration methods reported in scientific studies or research literature.

Such information is included only to describe existing research. It should not be interpreted as dosing advice or instructions for personal use.

AI-Generated Information

Atlas Longevity may use AI-powered tools to help visitors explore scientific and research information.

AI-generated responses can contain errors, incomplete information, or outdated findings. They should therefore be independently verified using reliable scientific sources.

AI content does not constitute medical or professional advice.


Community Content

Comments, experiences, reviews, questions, and other content submitted by users represent the views of those individuals.

Atlas Longevity does not necessarily verify or endorse user-generated content. Personal experiences should not be considered medical advice or evidence that another person will experience similar results.


Purchaser Responsibility

By purchasing from Atlas Longevity, you acknowledge that our products are supplied for research purposes and accept responsibility for their appropriate handling, storage, use, and disposal.

You are also responsible for ensuring that purchasing, possessing, importing, or using research compounds complies with the laws applicable in your jurisdiction.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Atlas Longevity is not responsible for consequences resulting from misuse, unauthorised use, improper handling of its products, or inappropriate reliance on information published on this website.


Contact

For questions regarding this disclaimer, please contact Atlas Longevity using the contact information available on our website.
